test_is_unsupported_parameter_error: run pytest tests to verify the generic unsupported parameter error detector matches real provider error messages
test_is_unsupported_temperature_error: run pytest tests to verify the back-compat temperature error wrapper delegates to the generic helper
test_call_llm_max_tokens_retry: run pytest tests to verify sync call_llm retries with max_completion_tokens when max_tokens is unsupported
test_async_call_llm_max_tokens_retry: run pytest tests to verify async async_call_llm retries with max_completion_tokens when max_tokens is unsupported
test_max_tokens_none_gate: run pytest tests to verify the max_tokens retry branch is skipped when max_tokens is None
